test_title: PYST 9: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some milk are curd.

Some curd are butter.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some milk are butter.

II. Some butter are curd.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Given Statements:

Some milk are curd.

Some curd are butter.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85f78572ddca88eed969076a688b996484ce4ac8634caec031a72741aab62a64.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some milk are butter - False (Because, No definite relation given between milk and butter, so it can be possible only).

II. Some butter are curd - True (Because, Some curd are butter also gives that some butter are curd).

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
